tools.name: health_check
tools.title: Server health check
tools.description: Returns basic server health: ok status, server time, and a request id. Does not require authentication.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.title: Get my Econology profile
tools.description: Returns the signed-in user's semantic Econology profile: literacy scores, mastered/weak/unknown concepts, diagnostic date and count, and (if stored) goals and learning preferences.

tools.name: get_progress
tools.title: Get my learning progress
tools.description: Returns the signed-in user's current and longest streak, total core lessons, total XP, and recent lesson concept IDs with scores and completion dates.

tools.name: list_portfolio
tools.title: List my portfolio tickers
tools.description: Returns the tickers the signed-in user tracks — ticker symbol and when it was added.

tools.name: list_pinned_articles
tools.title: List my pinned articles
tools.description: Returns the signed-in user's pinned economic-news articles with safe display fields only (title, url, site, symbol, published_date, snippet, image, pinned_at).

tools.name: add_portfolio_ticker
tools.title: Add a ticker to my portfolio
tools.description: Adds a stock ticker symbol to the signed-in user's Econology portfolio watchlist.

tools.name: remove_portfolio_ticker
tools.title: Remove a ticker from my portfolio
tools.description: Removes a stock ticker symbol from the signed-in user's Econology portfolio watchlist.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol to remove, e.g. AAPL.

tools.name: get_launch_metrics
tools.title: Get launch metrics (admin)
tools.description: Returns aggregated Econology launch metrics between two dates (new accounts, activation, D1/D7 retention, lessons per activated user, source-open rate, watchlist adoption, crash-free session rate). Admin only. No per-user rows.

start_date.description: Inclusive start date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 30 days ago.

end_date.description: Inclusive end date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today (UTC).
